verdict.rationale: Vanta has a dedicated SOC 2 product with automated tests, continuous monitoring, and AI evidence review (vanta-docs-10, vanta-docs-34, vanta-docs-49). It also documents pre-built frameworks with a control library (vanta-docs-12, vanta-docs-61, vanta-docs-63), AI policy drafting (vanta-docs-15), and auditor collaboration with information request lists (vanta-docs-11, vanta-docs-29, vanta-docs-8). Missing for 10: explicit Type I vs Type II workflow support, Trust Services Criteria named as the built-in control set, documented SOC 2 policy template coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
